prompt: Create ONE individually authored high-end 2.5D RPG animated VFX sprite sheet: OATH OF THE HOLY BLADE. It belongs to a handsome silver-haired knight in dark blue and polished silver plate with antique gold trim, wielding a long luminous silver greatsword. This sheet contains ONLY the changing sword-cut energy and struck material, no character, no weapon prop, no scenery. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen sequential equal square cells, requested 2048x2048. Fixed side-on slightly elevated camera, stable contact origin at x50%, y55% of EVERY cell. Entire effect, smoke, sparks and dim glow contained within CENTRAL 54% of each cell. Completely transparent empty gutters at least23% on every edge. No grid lines, letters, checkerboard, background or border. Chronological physically evolving silhouettes and internal matter each frame, NOT a repeated scaled or rotated static swoosh. Strong readable sword weight, elegant disciplined silver/cobalt/gold, short dense contact flash, fine painterly metal-vapor detail. Not a circular magic seal, not a big generic explosion, not a logo. Maintain one consistent virtual sword trajectory and spatial origin through all sixteen frames. No humanoids or numbers. Generate real alpha, not a painted checkerboard.
